name: frontend-testing
description: Frontend testing for production readiness, mapped to the Front-End-Checklist Testing category (13 rules). Defines a testing pyramid and emits copy-pasteable configs: Playwright (config + smoke specs), jest-axe / @axe-core/playwright a11y, Pact consumer-driven contract tests, and a GitHub Actions perf-budget + coverage CI. Scaffolds and advises - does not run the user's full CI. Composes with frontend-perfection, frontend-a11y, frontend-performance.
author: best
